description: This file provides a utility function 'apiGet' for making HTTP GET requests with automatic URL handling, authorization headers, and organization ID appending. It centralizes API call logic for the frontend, including URL construction, logging, and error handling.

methods.name: isAbsoluteUrl
methods.description: Checks if a URL is absolute (starts with http:// or https://).

methods.name: getBaseApiUrl
methods.description: Determines the base API URL from configuration, environment variables, or defaults to '/api'.

methods.name: joinUrl
methods.description: Joins a base URL with a relative or absolute path, handling special cases with /api.

methods.name: ensureOrgIdInUrl
methods.description: Appends organization_id or tenant_id to the URL if not already present.

methods.name: apiGet
methods.description: Performs a GET request to the specified URL or path, with URL resolution, headers, logging, and error handling.
